item.title: Winter cold returns, and it's set to get even colder this weekend
item.description: A cold front brought gusty winds and stalled temperatures to the area, with temperatures remaining in the 30s and 40s throughout the day, and a frigid weekend ahead with temperatures potentially dropping into the teens.

item.title: Missouri sees surge in flu cases, influenza A hits hard
item.description: SPRINGFIELD, Mo. — Missouri is one of 14 states experiencing the highest levels of flu activity in the nation, according to the latest map from the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention. Health officials say the surge is being fueled largely by Influenza A — a strain known to cause more severe illness and hospitalizations. [...]

item.title: Kehoe focusing on school district grades with executive order
item.description: Missouri Governor Mike Kehoe has signed an executive order to simplify the grading scale used to measure school growth, creating a statewide school accountability system with A-F grade cards to provide parents with clear and concise information about school performance.
